description: trunk-coverage.yml runs on every push to develop with cancel-in-progress (trunk-coverage.yml:3-12); between 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-24 that was about 42 push runs a day, of which about 17 completed and the rest were cancelled after about 14 minutes each. It runs the medium tier a third time per merge, instrumented, and occupies concurrency slots that PR CI waits for. Its only product is the coverage map that PR selection reads. Replace the push trigger with 4-6 scheduled runs a day (or a commit-distance guard on push), keeping dispatch and the daily staleness job. Scheduled maps are ignored today: PR selection trusts maps only from push and workflow_dispatch runs (scripts/coverage_test_selection.py:33, checked at :868 and :911), and every map-building job is skipped on schedule events (trunk-coverage.yml:21,73,168). Both must change, and the lookup window (MAX_MAP_BEHIND_COMMITS = 50 runs) must still reach a map. A new cron trigger needs owner approval before merge. The repository is public, so GitHub-hosted runner minutes are free; the binding limit is the concurrency cap. Queue time and PR time-to-green are the primary success metrics, runner-minutes secondary.
